name: Open Ownership
tagline: Driving the global shift towards transparency and accountability in corporate beneficial ownership.
policy_outcomes: Beneficial Ownership Data Standard (BODS) developed and published
Worldwide map tracking countries implementing beneficial ownership transparency
Supporting Zambia, Senegal, Philippines and other countries with legal reform
UNODC partnership on asset recovery best practices (UNCAC Resolution 10/6)
Since 2017 worked with governments in almost 90 countries on beneficial ownership reforms
outcome_methodology: Country case studies; impact stories; policy tracking map
failure_modes: register quality vs public access trade-offs
governance_model: Fiscally sponsored by Global Impact (US 501c3); day-to-day management by executive team; oversight by International Advisory Board (formed May 2025, superseded Steering Group); colleagues on five continents
contributor_governance: Open-source data standard with community input; helpdesk for government implementers
